description:
Check whether numbers can move to a new partner, without creating a request. Runs the same pre-flight checks
as 'create_partner_change_request' and reports every issue that would block the move (for example a number
that cannot move, a missing company detail, or a request that is already in progress).

Nothing is created or changed. Show the result to the user, then, if it is clear, call
'create_partner_change_request' with the same arguments.

items.description: Which payment plan (bundle) of the new partner a number moves onto. Needed when the new partner bills clients.

bundle_id.description: ID of the new partner's payment plan for this number.

channel_bundles.description: Optional. Which payment plan of the new partner each number moves onto. Only needed when the new partner bills its clients.

channel_ids.description: IDs of the numbers (channels) to move. Use 'list_channels' to find them. All numbers of a WABA have to move together.

target_client_id.description: Optional. ID of an existing client at the new partner to move the numbers into. Only for a partial move (not all numbers of the client). Needs to end with 'CL'.

target_partner_id.description: ID of the partner the numbers should move to. Needs to end with 'PA'.

name: preview_partner_change_request
title: Preview partner change request
